paragraphs: I started building in Roblox Studio in 2022 and got heavily involved in closed community games with small teams and solo developers ever since. I care about lore writing, portray settings best to the theme of the story, and immersing players into lore.

fun.title: The Resident
bio: Hey! My name is Ayden, and I am currently located in San Francisco, California, USA. Ever since I was a child, I was obssessed with playing Roblox everyday, and eventually I grew into wanting to create my own games, so I opened up the studio and it branched from there on. Musically and artistically, I've always been quite skilled. Playing the piano since I was a young child has given me musical ability from a young age, and as I grow older, I am inspired by my life and surroundings, allowing me to put my heart into music. On the other hand, I love to draw what I see and I love to draw what I literally love.

Outside of the arts, I'm a student obsessed with STEM too! Writing code and building machines was actually not my first interest, but I quickly learned it's my better skill.. I'm also a club swimmer and water polo player.
